summary.text:
LG INR21700 M50, discharge 1.5C 0%-100%, ambient 25 degC
Limits: T_peak <= 45 degC, in-cell dT <= 5 degC, ready again within 180 min
39 designs, 20 feasible, 4 on the trade-off front
NOTE: bottom plates are solved in 2D (radius x height). A chiller pulling a hot-soaked pack down through its base opens large top-to-bottom gradients while it does so.
NOTE: liquid pump power covers the whole loop (7.9 mW/cell at most) and the radiator fan is charged at 3 % of the heat it rejects; chiller idle losses are not included.
Lightest       air 0.6 g/s, no filler: T_peak 40.1 degC, +1.8% mass, aux 6.35% of energy, recovery 18 min
Lowest energy  ribbon 0.02 g/s, 3.5 mm gap, RT42: T_peak 42.6 degC, +19.9% mass, aux 0.15% of energy, recovery 71 min
Balanced       ribbon 0.05 g/s, 3.5 mm gap, no filler: T_peak 41.1 degC, +7.2% mass, aux 0.19% of energy, recovery 22 min
Not picked     air 0.3 g/s, no filler: +1.8% mass, aux 1.12%, but fails (hot) at worst-case R0 = 43 mOhm (peak 48.5 degC)
Not picked     bottom 0.02 g/s, RT31: +17.9% mass, aux 0.16%, but fails (hot · uneven) at worst-case R0 = 43 mOhm (peak 52.5 degC)
Not picked     bottom 0.02 g/s, RT42: +18.2% mass, aux 0.15%, but fails (hot · uneven) at worst-case R0 = 43 mOhm (peak 47.4 degC)
